purpose: Whole-ladder roadmap for durable technology progression roles and current working/candidate states. Checkpoint evidence and simulation methodology remain external.

statusDefinitions.current_working: Current accepted/working architecture or numerical value already supported by contemporary evidence; may still be explicitly provisional where noted.
statusDefinitions.legacy_candidate: Previously accepted or tested value from an older architecture retained as a candidate requiring revalidation under the current rules.
statusDefinitions.hypothesis: New design proposal for future testing; not production data.
statusDefinitions.deferred: Conceptual role or question intentionally left without a numerical commitment.
statusDefinitions.validated_working_candidate: Supported strongly enough for continued integration, but still subject to cross-TL validation and explicit human promotion.
statusDefinitions.cross_tl_validated_candidate: Survived broader mixed-tech or exact-edge cross-TL integration and remains a candidate pending final production promotion.

researchCategoryOwnership.note: Sensor, ECM, and ECCM remain separate progression streams inside Sensors / EW; weapon families keep distinct progression identities; the matrix does not create extra player-visible research categories.

globalGuardrails: Technology levels are discipline-specific capability levels, not a global multiplier or fixed TL-versus-TL win target.
Do not require every stream or statistic to improve at every TL; advancement may be capability, efficiency, resilience, mode, integration, miniaturization, or frontier performance.
Subsystem-family identity is mandatory: higher TL advances each family only along appropriate directions; shared sensitivity axes such as APEN/SPEN do not imply universal stat progression.
Use introduction -> maturation/integration -> peak only where it fits naturally; do not force a repeating cadence.
Older technology may continue to mature after a successor appears when it retains a real niche.
Progression must remain coherent under Installation Space, Tactical Power, prerequisite, stacking, and mixed-TL constraints.
Cross-category prerequisites must be sparse, causal, and normally limited to one or two genuinely enabling dependencies.
Mixed-TL ships are mandatory stress cases; broad low-TL research never synthesizes a de facto high-TL capability.
Degraded direct fire remains weapon-specific permission plus Tactical Computer-owned penalty; degraded fire must remain materially inferior to restoring Firm with ECCM.
Sensor reach, discrimination, ECM, ECCM, and Tactical Computer progression must be reviewed together when an interacting dependency changes.
Higher-TL systems may legitimately demand more Tactical Power when they push a capability frontier; power efficiency is a separate progression axis and is never granted implicitly.

Tall research may expose real reactor and opportunity-cost constraints, but technology progression must broaden or improve viable solutions rather than systematically make advanced equipment unusable; high-demand tall builds and reactor constraints must remain viable integration cases.
Ordinary missiles retain their separate Firm-terminal architecture; future Approximate-volume missile capabilities are missile-specific rather than inherited from direct-fire degraded fire.

Power / Reactor is a first-class progression stream. Reactor output, output density, efficiency, condition mapping, overload behavior, storage, auxiliary generation, and footprint are separate axes; changing one does not silently improve the others.

Do not ban stacking mature legacy reactors merely to force a frontier reactor to dominate. Compare real Installation Space, Tactical Power, reliability, and opportunity costs under the current hull architecture.

Shield progression is factored by capacity, recharge, hardening, condition behavior, Tactical Power maintenance/boost, and Installation Space. Integer damage/recharge breakpoints are real effects to review, not uniform percentage progression.

Armor Protection and Armor Integrity are separate progression axes. Preserve weapon APEN counterplay and do not bundle AP, AI, footprint, repair, ablative behavior, or special materials without independent evidence.

Every ordinary legal combat ship requires at least one Main Weapon, one Reactor, and one installed Sensor. A second Main Weapon, second Reactor, or both remain optional explicit design choices; ECM/ECCM remain optional. Sensorless configurations are reserved for explicit diagnostics, special scenario objects, or post-damage states rather than normal construction.

Multiple ECM or ECCM installations may provide redundancy, but same-type ratings never add. Use the highest applicable functional rating; cooperative allied effects remain separately capped mechanics.

The TL3 base row is a standard technology table, not the complete future catalog: later pinnacle legacy-family items and additional Aux/specialist components may be added without changing base-row identity.

tacticalComputer.role: Electronic fire-control baseline: ordinary direct-fire assistance plus support for weapon-specific Approximate-track fire.
tacticalComputer.notes: -25 applies only when the weapon explicitly supports degraded fire. Computer damage-condition effects on degraded fire remain deferred.

sensor.role: Baseline radio/optical sensing with passive-first doctrine and one normal Active mode; physical reach and EW discrimination remain separate.
sensor.notes: Balanced-0 remains a calibration fixture, not a production range promotion.

ecm.role: Baseline conventional powered jamming; conspicuous active emission attacks discrimination rather than physical sensor reach.

eccm.role: Baseline powered counter-jamming; offsets ECM discrimination margin but does not extend sensor reach or promote a baseline Approximate observation to Firm.

powerReactor.role: Peak fission: mature dependable baseline power architecture.
powerReactor.notes: TL1 safe overload remains the current working behavior where legal; no TL2 inference is made from it.

shield.role: Baseline shield generator and field capacity.

tacticalComputer.role: Refined track fusion and conventional targeting; retain the TL1 degraded-fire penalty initially so improved ordinary targeting does not also weaken the EW guardrail.
tacticalComputer.notes: Ordinary targeting +12 is the current local working candidate; degraded-fire penalty -25 and Evasive Compensation 0 remain held.

sensor.role: First discrimination-focused maturation: better intrinsic resistance to obsolete jamming before adding more reach or more Active modes.
sensor.notes: DR1 is the current local working candidate. Physical reach remains on the unchanged Balanced-0 study fixture; no TL2 range increase is promoted.

ecm.role: Strength refinement through scalable normal rating while preserving one Tactical Power per rating as the initial comparison point.
ecm.notes: Normal ceiling 2 at 1 TP/rating is the current local working candidate. New TL2 overload/efficiency behavior remains deferred.

eccm.role: Counter-strength refinement through scalable normal rating; works with intrinsic Sensor Discrimination Resistance rather than replacing it.
eccm.notes: Normal ceiling 2 at 1 TP/rating is the current local working candidate. The wide old-Sensor route remains mechanically valid but more power-hungry than DR1 + ECCM1.

powerReactor.role: Early practical fusion: validated current-architecture Operational-output density candidate.
powerReactor.notes: 6 Operational TP at 6 Space is the current local working candidate. All other reactor properties remain separate and unpromoted.

shield.role: First validated Shield progression step: Capacity 3 at the unchanged 3-Space footprint.
shield.notes: Capacity 3 at 3 Space is now a cross-TL validated candidate. Capacity 4 remains upper sensitivity; no other shield property is promoted.

armor.role: Ceramic-composite durability maturation with Armor Integrity emphasized before flat Protection.
armor.notes: AP0/AI5 is now a cross-TL validated candidate. AP1 was not promoted at TL2; CP102 implements AP1/AI5 as the distinct TL3 executable candidate while leaving calibration and production promotion unresolved.

tacticalComputer.role: Mature integrated fire control: retain TL2 ordinary solution quality while reducing the ship own-fire cost of Evasive posture.
tacticalComputer.notes: CP102 native-accepted executable binding; CP101 value unchanged. Evasive Compensation offsets only the own-fire Evasive penalty to a minimum of zero and never becomes a positive bonus.

sensor.role: Mature active-sensor integration: preserve DR1 and passive reach while adding Low/High normal Active modes.
sensor.notes: High Active converts the current overload-level 4/5 reach into a normal 2-TP mode without Strain; no 5/6 overload is assumed.

ecm.role: Mature rating-2 ECM through power efficiency rather than stronger jamming.

eccm.role: Mature rating-2 ECCM through power efficiency rather than stronger counter-jamming.

powerReactor.role: Mature Compact Fusion: miniaturize the TL2 fusion output package rather than raising raw output.
powerReactor.notes: CP102 native-accepted executable binding; CP101 value unchanged. Footprint improves from 6 to 5 Space; no new output, overload, storage, or reliability benefit is bundled.

shield.role: Mature shield integration: hold primary Capacity 3 and unlock a separate powered Shield Hardener option.
shield.notes: Initial TL3 candidate; the hardener is a separate optional support component rather than an automatic base-shield increase.

armor.role: Mature composite protection: convert material maturity into actual flat Protection while holding TL2 Integrity.
armor.notes: Initial TL3 candidate AP1/AI5. This exposes a natural breakpoint for existing Kinetic APEN1 without promoting another Kinetic penetration increase.

hull.notes: Capacity rises by the minimum integer step 35->36. Hull durability, personnel, cargo and shuttle capacity do not also increase. Structural refit requires drydock/rare equivalent.

stlDrive.notes: Normal Move follows installed STL TL. The bounded overload remains +1 Move rather than scaling multiplicatively with base Move; no footprint reduction is bundled.

ftlDrive.notes: Strategic Move follows installed FTL TL. No footprint reduction, faster preparation, or exploration-bypass benefit is bundled.

kineticMainWeapon.notes: Hold packet, range, accuracy and penetration; maturation removes the ordinary discretionary Tactical-Power firing burden. Finite ammunition remains the family cost. No Approximate-fire permission is bundled.

energyMainWeapon.notes: The former TL1 overload-level DAM4 output becomes a rated safe High mode. No automatic DAM5/4-TP overload is created.

missileMainWeapon.notes: Maturation is propulsion/autonomy rather than a larger warhead. Onboard navigation sensing becomes standard for local tracking/reacquisition; seeker remains an optional later subcomponent/variant.

kineticPds.notes: Deliberate base TL3 hold; no placeholder improvement. Existing local/self-contained PDS rules remain.

energyPds.notes: Principal maturation is readiness efficiency from 2 TP to 1 TP; accuracy and RC are held.

ammPds.notes: Accuracy and magazine are held; the player may spend another readiness TP for a second total reaction, preserving the normal two-attempt-per-flight cap and automatic seeded allocation.

tacticalComputer.role: Predictive multi-variable fire-control foundation; emphasize new solution quality or integration rather than a generic accuracy increment.

sensor.role: New/exotic signature-channel or environmental-tolerance frontier; exact fiction and mechanics remain open.

ecm.role: Adaptive/cooperative screen capability; possible qualitative mode rather than simple rating inflation.

eccm.role: Adaptive discrimination/anti-deception capability; must remain distinct from physical sensor reach.

powerReactor.role: High-output fusion: mature fusion pushes the usable-output frontier or another genuinely output-related capability.

shield.role: Future shield progression role intentionally deferred until lower-TL capacity/recharge/power interactions are calibrated.

armor.role: Advanced composite/layered protection with explicit APEN counterplay.

tacticalComputer.role: Predictive engagement maturation. Evasive Compensation becomes a candidate capability if contemporary movement/EW tests justify it.

sensor.role: Advanced trajectory/signature awareness and reacquisition; a gravitic-style sensing principle is a conceptual candidate, not a locked name.

ecm.role: Deception sophistication or target-picture manipulation while remaining an observable active emission when powered.

eccm.role: Deeper integration with sensor fusion and deceptive-signal rejection.

powerReactor.role: Early antimatter plus peak fusion: new high-energy family appears while mature fusion retains a final strategically relevant niche.

shield.role: Future shield progression role intentionally deferred until lower-TL capacity/recharge/power interactions are calibrated.

armor.role: High-energy or ablative specialization may introduce new armor roles rather than universal scalar growth.

tacticalComputer.role: Distributed/resilient tactical computing; emphasize coordination and graceful operation under component damage or network disruption.

sensor.role: Advanced discrimination, track freshness, and resilience; exact range growth remains a separate decision.

ecm.role: Higher reliability/strength frontier with explicit Tactical Power and counterplay costs.

eccm.role: Higher reliability/strength frontier without becoming a reach extender.

powerReactor.role: Mature antimatter: containment, conditioning, integration, reliability, or miniaturization improve.

shield.role: Future shield progression role intentionally deferred until lower-TL capacity/recharge/power interactions are calibrated.

armor.role: Resilient smart materials, damage localization, or repair behavior as separate properties.

tacticalComputer.role: Low-latency networked tactical coordination across ship systems and legitimate shared information.

sensor.role: Advanced-drive/FTL-signature sensing and high-quality network integration, preserving fog-of-war.

ecm.role: Networked/distributed jamming or cooperative emission management.

eccm.role: Networked/distributed discrimination processing and counter-jamming coordination.

powerReactor.role: High-output antimatter: mature antimatter reaches a strong performance form.

shield.role: Future shield progression role intentionally deferred until lower-TL capacity/recharge/power interactions are calibrated.

armor.role: Adaptive/metamaterial protection with explicit weapon-family counters.

tacticalComputer.role: Causal/predictive inference and very high integration efficiency; no omniscience and no automatic removal of uncertainty.

sensor.role: Metric-gradient/high-precision sensing with efficiency and discrimination emphasis.

ecm.role: Selective shaping/efficiency improvements rather than unlimited brute-force rating.

eccm.role: Predictive filtering/efficiency improvements against sophisticated jamming.

powerReactor.role: Direct/fractional matter conversion plus peak antimatter: a new conversion frontier appears while antimatter receives its final mature option.

shield.role: Future shield progression role intentionally deferred until lower-TL capacity/recharge/power interactions are calibrated.

armor.role: Exotic material or field-assisted armor with explicit footprint/power requirements.

tacticalComputer.role: Pinnacle tactical cognition/support architecture. It remains a fire-control aid rather than an autonomous omniscient commander.

sensor.role: Pinnacle information advantage while preserving uncertainty, line of sight, and game-relevant fog-of-war.

ecm.role: Pinnacle multi-spectrum denial with meaningful power/emission/counter-EW tradeoffs.

eccm.role: Pinnacle discrimination support that still cannot create physical reach or manufacture Firm from intrinsically Approximate information.

powerReactor.role: Total matter conversion: pinnacle player power architecture; exact output/efficiency/resilience profile remains future design.

shield.role: Future shield progression role intentionally deferred until lower-TL capacity/recharge/power interactions are calibrated.

armor.role: Pinnacle structural protection that still preserves Hull and penetration relevance.

tl2CandidateInteractionExamples.meaning: A TL2 discrimination upgrade can resist the obsolete TL1 jammer without powered ECCM in ordinary non-same-hex geometry.
A contemporary TL2 jammer still degrades an otherwise Firm observation.

tl2CandidateInteractionExamples.case: TL2 ECM against TL2 Sensor + ECCM 1
tl2CandidateInteractionExamples.meaning: One powered ECCM point plus the sensor's intrinsic resistance restores the discrimination contest; jammer spends 2 TP while the observer spends 1 ECCM TP.

tl2CandidateInteractionExamples.case: TL2 ECM against TL1 Sensor + TL2 ECCM 2
tl2CandidateInteractionExamples.meaning: A wide research path can counter the stronger jammer by paying the full 2-TP ECCM cost even with the old sensor.

tl2CandidateInteractionExamples.case: TL2 ECM against TL1 Sensor + TL1 ECCM 1
tl2CandidateInteractionExamples.meaning: The taller jammer defeats the old defensive package, preserving a meaningful technology frontier.

weaponFamilyPenetrationArchitecture.notes: Kinetic APEN1 is carried as the locally validated TL2 penetration candidate. Energy and Missile retain their current penetration profiles for cross-TL integration; future progression may use different family-appropriate properties.

integrationArchitecture.principle: CP99 v6 remains the frozen TL1/TL2 exact-edge regression consumer. CP102 v7 is the native-accepted executable TL3 construction/transition baseline. CP103 v8 is native-accepted substantive population/all-tier screening evidence. CP104 adds one zero-weight targeted TL3 diagnostic closure and then hands planning to higher-TL subsystem-chart expansion unless an architectural defect blocks broader work.

integrationCoverage.note: CP102 executable counts are native-accepted implementation/integration evidence. Its 32 one-trial variants are pipeline smoke only and must not be interpreted as balance evidence; CP103 adds substantive review-only measurement without automatic promotion.
